title: Cancer: current or history, and metastases
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's cancer as documented at this visit.
note:
Chief Complaint: Bone pain.

HPI: Pt is an 85 y/o female presenting for f/u of metastatic to bone. Pt has a hx of cancer of the right breast. Primary tumor was surgically removed and treated several years ago. She reports that the initial treatment is complete and there is no evidence of local recurrence at the primary site. However, she now reports localized aching in the spine and hips. She describes the pain as a dull ache, rated 4/10, worsening at night. Denies any new neurological deficits or significant weight loss.

Medication List:
- Acetaminophen 650mg BID PRN for pain
- Lisinopril 10mg daily
- Atorvastatin 20mg daily

Vitals:
BP: 132/78
HR: 74 (RRR)
Temp: 98.6 F
SpO2: 97% on RA
Ht/Wt: 58 kg

Recent Labs:
Hb: 12.4 g/dL
WBC: 7.2 K/uL
Plt: 210 K/uL
eGFR: 65 mL/min/1.73m2
Ca: 9.4 mg/dL

Review of Systems:
Constitutional: Denies fever, chills, fatigue.
Musculoskeletal: Positive for back and hip aching. Denies joint swelling.
Neuro: Denies numbness, tingling, or weakness.
CV: Denies chest pain or palpitations.
Resp: Denies SOB or cough.

Social History: Pt lives with her spouse in a single-story home. Retired. Non-smoker. Occasional alcohol use.

Family History: Mother had breast cancer. Father had hypertension.

Exam:
General: Alert and oriented x3. In no acute distress.
Skin: No new lesions noted.
Musculoskeletal: Mild tenderness over T12 and L4 spinous processes. Range of motion limited by discomfort. No step-off noted.
Neuro: Strength 5/5 throughout. Reflexes 2+ symmetric.

Assessment:
1. Bone metastasis: Pt experiencing localized pain. Management focused on palliative comfort.
2. History of cancer of the right breast: Stable, no evidence of local recurrence at primary site.

Plan:
- Continue current pain regimen.
- Increase Acetaminophen to 1000mg every 6 hours PRN for severe pain.
- Order X-ray of spine and pelvis to evaluate site of bone metastasis.
- F/u in 4 weeks to monitor symptoms.

Electronically signed,
D. Kowalski, DO
05/14/2026
explanations: The right female breast cancer was excised or eradicated, no treatment is directed to it and there is no evidence of it: personal history Z85.3 (no HCC). Any metastasis is still coded as a current secondary malignancy.
Bone metastases: C79.51, secondary malignant neoplasm of bone (HCC 18, which outranks the primary-site HCC).

distractors.why: Treatment ended and there is no evidence of the primary: code personal history (Z85), not active cancer.
Metastasis is coded as a secondary malignancy, even when the primary is history.
The metastases are in bone, not the liver.

hccs.label: Cancer Metastatic to Bone/Other and Unspecified Metastatic Cancer; Acute Leukemia Except Myeloid
